meaning:
κατ-άγνυμι
[in LXX for נָחַת pi., etc. ;]
to break: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.12:20 (LXX), Jhn.19:31-33.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.
Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one)…
